functions.name: get_doctor_availability
functions.description: Check doctor availability for appointment booking. Call this as soon as you have a doctor name and date — you do NOT need to ask the user for a time window. Default start_time to '00:00' and end_time to '23:59' to check the full day. end_date should equal start_date unless checking multiple days.

doctor_name.description: Name of the doctor to check availability for

start_date.description: Start date for availability check in YYYY-MM-DD format

end_date.description: End date for availability check in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use the same value as start_date when checking a single day.

start_time.description: Start time in HH:MM 24-hour format. Default to '00:00' if the user has not specified a time preference.

end_time.description: End time in HH:MM 24-hour format. Default to '23:59' if the user has not specified a time preference.

functions.name: get_all_doctors
functions.description: Get a list of all available doctors in the clinic

functions.name: get_patient_details
functions.description: Retrieve patient details using their phone number. CRITICAL: You MUST verify doctor availability using `get_doctor_availability` BEFORE calling this function or asking the user for any personal details.

functions.name: book_appointment
functions.description: Book a medical appointment for a patient. CRITICAL PRE-CONDITIONS — you MUST satisfy ALL of these before calling this function: (1) Verify doctor availability with `get_doctor_availability`. (2) Collect or confirm patient_name and patient_email — if an existing record was found via `get_patient_details`, you MUST still read the name and email back to the caller and receive an explicit verbal 'yes' before proceeding. (3) Speak the mandatory confirmation phrase: 'Just to confirm — I will be booking the appointment under the name [Full Name] with the email [Email]. Shall I go ahead?' (translate this phrase into the currently active language) and wait for an affirmative reply. NEVER call this function if the caller has not explicitly confirmed their name and email in this call, regardless of what the patient record contains. NEVER fabricate, guess, or use placeholder values.

patient_name.description: Full name of the patient — MUST be explicitly provided by the user during the conversation. Never guess or fabricate.

patient_email.description: Patient's email address — MUST be explicitly provided by the user. Convert spoken format to standard (e.g. 'john at gmail dot com' -> 'john@gmail.com').

patient_dob.description: Patient's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format — ask the user for this. Optional: if user declines, pass empty string.

patient_gender.description: Patient's gender (Male/Female) — ask the user once. Optional: if user declines, pass empty string.

doctor_id.description: ID of the doctor for the appointment

slot_start_time.description: Appointment start time in HH:MM format

functions.name: get_appointments
functions.description: Get all appointments for a patient using their phone number

functions.name: initiate_cancel_appointment
functions.description: Start the appointment cancellation process by asking for the patient's phone number and fetching all their appointments. Use this when the user wants to cancel an appointment. This will retrieve and present all appointments to the user so they can choose which one to cancel.

requested_date.description: The date the user requested to cancel, if mentioned.

requested_time.description: The time the user requested to cancel, if mentioned.

functions.name: confirm_cancel_appointment
functions.description: Complete the appointment cancellation after the user has selected which appointment to cancel from the list. Use this only after presenting appointments to the user and they have chosen one to cancel.

appointment_id.description: ID of the appointment to cancel

functions.name: initiate_reschedule_appointment
functions.description: Start the appointment rescheduling process by fetching all their appointments. Use this when the user wants to reschedule an appointment. You MUST pass the requested_date and requested_time if the user mentioned them, so you don't forget them.

requested_date.description: The date the user requested to reschedule to, if mentioned.

requested_time.description: The time the user requested to reschedule to, if mentioned.

functions.name: confirm_reschedule_appointment
functions.description: Complete the appointment rescheduling after the user has selected which appointment to reschedule and provided the new date and time. Use this only after presenting appointments to the user and they have chosen one to reschedule with a new date and time.

appointment_id.description: ID of the appointment to reschedule

new_date.description: New appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format

new_time.description: New appointment time in HH:MM format (24-hour)

functions.name: handle_general_inquiry
functions.description: Handle general inquiries about clinic hours, services, fees, etc.

inquiry_type.description: Type of inquiry (clinic_hours, contact, services, appointment_fee, cancellation_policy, etc.)

functions.name: create_ticket
functions.description: Create a support ticket when the user wants to speak to a real person or is frustrated. Call this immediately without trying to convince the user to stay.

ticket_desc.description: Brief description of why the user wants to escalate

patient_name.description: Name of the patient if already collected

patient_phone_number.description: Patient phone number if already collected

doctor_name.description: Doctor name if relevant to the issue
